column1: # Applied symbol names for ps4-omega-eu eboot.bin (image base 0x01000000).
# The evidence lives in the page named in the last column; this file exists so
# the names can be re-applied to a fresh Ghidra database without hand-editing.
# Run `just apply-names` after importing eboot.bin with GhidraOrbis (see
# docs/reverse-engineering/toolchain.md#ps4). See ADR-0005: the pages are the
# record of truth, and scripts/apply-ghidra-names.py checks that every row
# here still appears in its evidence page before it renames anything.
# kind is `function` or `data`. Confidence below 70 gets a `_q` suffix applied,
# below 50 is skipped. Recovered library and import symbols (the `sceXxx`
# names NIDAnalyzer resolves automatically on import) keep their real names
# rather than the project's Subsystem_VerbNoun scheme, same as elsewhere.
